sn22.36:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.36:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.36:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu anuseti taṃ anumiyyati
sn22.36:1.7: yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.36:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.36:2.9: rūpañce bhante nānuseti na taṃ anumiyyati
sn22.36:2.10: yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.15: yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.16: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.36:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.36:3.10: rūpañce bhikkhu nānuseti na taṃ anumiyyati
sn22.36:3.11: yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:3.16: yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:3.17: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti …pe…
sn22.36:3.18: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
